dispositions.rationale: Deleted by ADR-0294 D2 (2026-08-03): duplicates lower-tier proof. `uatc_022a155228bc9924c4875e84` ("the seam is runtime-agnostic") is proven by the capability `phase-author-seam`, at `packages/agent/src/sdk-author.test.ts` (over an injected `queryFn`) and `codex-author.test.ts` (over an injected runner), observed by `agent#gate-1`. This is the criterion ADR-0294 D1 quotes as its worked example of a property of a module rather than a journey step.

Deleted by ADR-0294 D2 (2026-08-03): duplicates lower-tier proof. `uatc_06cc2a84373bb97a0aa7e0ae` ("the model is swappable" — `ScriptedModel` drives the loop with zero live calls, running past the scripted end is a LOUD error, `@anthropic-ai/sdk` imports confined to `model.ts`) is proven by the capability `model-runtime-seam`, at `packages/agent/src/model.test.ts` and `run-turn.test.ts`, observed by `agent#gate-1`.

Deleted by ADR-0294 D2 (2026-08-03): duplicates lower-tier proof. `uatc_87dfb002958176d8e4b566ea` ("the tool surface is confined" — a path outside the workspace is refused with `PathEscapeError` returned as a tool result, never a thrown crash) is proven by the capability `leaf-tool-surface`, at `packages/agent/src/fs-tools.test.ts` (path-escape + error-as-result) and `tool-executor.test.ts` (unknown tool / throwing handler captured as `is_error`), observed by `agent#gate-1`.

Deleted by ADR-0294 D2 (2026-08-03): duplicates lower-tier proof. `uatc_07ab4bbca22ca84a6772c53e` ("a step fails closed" — malformed/wrong-shape model JSON makes `runStepValidated` retry then HALT to `ValidationFailed`, never a forged success) is proven by the capability `owned-turn-loop`, at `packages/agent/src/step.test.ts`, observed by `agent#gate-1`.
Unresolved at cutover: the positional key alone cannot establish continuity across pre-ADR-0253 revisions. History is retained for review and earns no current proof credit.

Deleted by ADR-0294 D2 (2026-08-03): duplicates lower-tier proof. `uatc_bf5fccace84b18f4b3615108` ("feedback is a doorbell, not a shell" — bounded in-process MCP tools, the leaf controls ZERO arguments, output is feedback only) is proven by the capability `live-sdk-leaf`, at `packages/agent/src/sdk-author.test.ts` (`executeFeedback` / `formatFeedbackOutput`), observed by `agent#gate-1`. NOTE: `agent#uat-5` is NOT deleted — it survives as the story's single journey leg, with its `witness: human` tag and its two signed `operator` rows left untouched as an explicit open OWNER call.

Deleted by ADR-0294 D2 (2026-08-08): duplicates lower-tier proof, and named its own capability in its own success clause. `uatc_68cf75456b5e5d05de9ec7d2` ("The transcript persists across turns") is proven by the capability `multi-turn-transcript`, at `apps/studio/src/components/ChatPanel.test.tsx` — "mtt-appends-not-replaces: a second send appends a new exchange without discarding the first — both present, in order, newest last", "mtt-echoes-each-prompt: each send appends its `› <prompt>` echo line above its reply, per turn" and "mtt-auto-scrolls-to-newest" — observed by `app-guide#gate-1`, whose command is the same `pnpm --filter studio test` that greens that capability.

Deleted by ADR-0294 D2 (2026-08-08): duplicates lower-tier proof, and named its own capability in its own success clause. `uatc_900ddbae4fabec17da85c4c6` ("The input grows and caps") is proven by the capability `auto-grow-input`, at `apps/studio/src/components/ChatPanel.test.tsx` — "agi-recomputes-height-from-content" (the height recompute), "agi-caps-height-and-scrolls-internally: past a max height the textarea clamps at the cap and scrolls inside itself" (the cap and internal scrolling) and "agi-keeps-enter-send-shift-enter-newline" (the preserved Enter/Shift+Enter keybindings) — observed by `app-guide#gate-1`.

Deleted by ADR-0294 D2 (2026-08-08): duplicates lower-tier proof, and named its own capability in its own success clause. `uatc_9f5912771ca744fcae515a44` ("Reset clears and aborts") is proven by the capability `transcript-reset`, at `apps/studio/src/components/ChatPanel.test.tsx` — "tr-clears-transcript-to-idle: clicking reset empties the transcript back to the idle empty state (input cleared + re-enabled + resting height)" and "tr-aborts-in-flight-stream: clicking reset mid-stream aborts the in-flight stream (the passed signal is aborted) and leaves no ghost reply in the cleared transcript" — observed by `app-guide#gate-1`.

Deleted by ADR-0294 D2 (2026-08-08): duplicates lower-tier proof. `uatc_64fcbdd6348c342b802efad7` ("The world presentation is deterministic and authority-free") is proven by the capability `app-surface-world-view`, at `packages/app-surface/src/WorldSceneView.test.tsx` — "aswv-equal-plain-inputs-normalize-deterministically" (equal renders from equal inputs), "aswv-wrapper-has-no-private-or-live-authority" (no fetch/store/clock authority) and "aswv-delegates-one-semantic-scene-and-event" (reports only typed world events) — observed by `app-surface#gate-1`, whose `covers:` annotation names that same capability.

Deleted by ADR-0294 D2 (2026-08-08): duplicates lower-tier proof. `uatc_039b8b6ddb147d375c932c7e` ("TreeView is the real first consumer") is proven by the capability `studio-app-surface-adapter`, at `apps/studio/src/components/TreeViewShell.test.tsx` — "asa-treeview-mounts-one-shared-world-view" asserts the mount-with-no-second-private-scene-mapper claim — observed by `app-surface#gate-2`. The leg's state-folding / selection-callback half was explicitly declared a standing gap in its own text and was never claimed, so nothing proven is lost.

Deleted by ADR-0294 D2 (2026-08-08): duplicates lower-tier proof. `uatc_fcd45a1512795648a5521f4e` ("Existing art and selector policy survive") is proven by the capability `app-surface-world-view` under the same `pnpm --filter @storytree/app-surface test` command that `app-surface#gate-1` observes: `SceneView.test.tsx` and `SceneView.vegetation.test.tsx` (fallback, ground contact, depth order), `sprite-sizing.test.ts` (sizing), `trailReveal.test.ts` and `semantic-growth-trail-reveal.test.tsx` (trail reveal), `vegetation-render.test.ts` (arrival growth).

Deleted by ADR-0294 D2 (2026-08-08): duplicates lower-tier proof. `uatc_f5cd373a0b8a0e3f9a1875d4` ("The semantic walk exposes six honest states") is proven by the capability `semantic-growth-replay-view`, at `apps/studio/src/components/TreeViewShell.test.tsx` — "signed-proof stays proposed/non-healthy while carrying the proof bloom; healthy appears only last" asserts both the presence-distinct-from-proof clause and the healthy-appears-last clause, and "sgsd-companion-witness-territory" asserts the six observed keys of the primary's walk — observed by `app-surface#gate-3`.

Deleted by ADR-0294 D2 (2026-08-08): duplicates lower-tier proof. `uatc_5b9f6145b996d8c392101b81` ("Navigation and reduced motion preserve semantics") is proven by the capability `semantic-growth-replay-view`, at `packages/app-surface/src/SemanticGrowthWorldView.test.tsx` — "plays the supplied semantic sequence deterministically, clamps navigation, and renders its real scene immediately without motion when reduced" and "settles reduced motion immediately to and retains both final mature poses" — observed by `app-surface#gate-3`.

Deleted by ADR-0294 D2 (2026-08-08): duplicates lower-tier proof. `uatc_4ea0ef71ec37e25732fb26fc` ("The earlier semantic witness remains isolated from clean Studio") is proven by the capability `semantic-growth-studio-demo`, at `apps/studio/src/components/TreeViewShell.test.tsx` — "the clean route (and any unknown value) never mounts the demo; only the exact flag mounts one public six-frame player, steppable via its own Next control" restates this leg verbatim, and "sgsd-composed-through-real-studio-world-pipeline" asserts the real-composition-path half — observed by `app-surface#gate-4`.

Deleted by ADR-0294 D2 (2026-08-08): duplicates lower-tier proof. `uatc_e92ecfa2a181ca2b109d7a8f` ("Native land grows without changing the island or camera") is proven by the capability `svg-island-growth-track`, at `packages/app-surface/src/svg-island-accretion.test.tsx` — "locally scales real cell paths without opacity, keeps coast/camera/anchor/painter and interaction geometry fixed" (grows in place at the established view box, parcel and painter slot), "uses the existing app clock for deterministic Back/Replay" (equal progress yields equal geometry) and "keeps the accretion runtime deterministic, SVG-only, and free of PixelLab/network/opacity animation authority" (no raster frame, no second renderer, no random value, no asset clock) — observed by `app-surface#gate-5`. NOTE: that capability's recorded `proof.real.testFile` still names `packages/app-surface/src/svg-island-growth.test.tsx`, which does not exist; the assertions above were located by reading the package, not by trusting the path. The binding drift is left for its owner.

Deleted by ADR-0294 D2 (2026-08-08): duplicates lower-tier proof. `uatc_deda5e5db5d7520161632855` ("Small-plant tracks are local, registered and product-driven") is proven by the capability `pixellab-organic-growth-tracks`, at `packages/app-surface/src/organic-pose-to-pose-track.test.ts` and `organic-pose-to-pose-assets.test.ts` — "registers separate transparent local hero-tree and bounded plant tracks with costs" (provenance, transparent local frames, bounded families), "requires registered anchors normalized only by recorded author-time offsets" (ground sockets, normalization), "makes Next, Back, and Replay select equivalent cue, progress, and frames" (equal cue/progress selects equal frames; Back/Replay settle identically) and "rejects remote/runtime vendor, credential, client, and asset-clock fields" (no runtime PixelLab dependency) — observed by `app-surface#gate-6`. NOTE: that capability's recorded `proof.real.testFile` still names `packages/app-surface/src/organic-growth-track.test.tsx`, which does not exist; the binding drift is left for its owner.

Deleted by ADR-0294 D2 (2026-08-08): duplicates lower-tier proof. `uatc_0af87458e18a9d4495d21191` ("The corrected real-consumer route is exact and ordinary Studio stays ordinary") is proven by the capability `organic-growth-app-witness`, at `apps/studio/src/components/TreeViewShell.test.tsx` — "only the exact organic-pose-to-pose gate grows local registered poses over the retained real SVG island, with stable Back/Replay sockets" and "only the exact organic-island-accretion gate reuses the canonical 50-cell pose fixture as a connected adjacency wave … without changing any existing behaviour" assert the exact-query-only mount over the real composition path, and "only the exact `r3-lab` value mounts the lab; clean, unknown and near-miss routes fall through byte-identically and no sibling gate moves" asserts the clean/near-miss retention — observed by `app-surface#gate-7`.

Deleted by ADR-0294 D2 (2026-08-03): duplicates lower-tier proof. `uatc_e86cbe78a9f321c3b12aca91` (the gate stamps `verdict.boundHash` and emits exactly one `ChangeEvent` with a binding, and signs unchanged without one) is proven by the capability `gate-emits-change`, at `packages/orchestrator/src/gate-emits-change.test.ts`, which asserts BOTH branches. Deleted by ADR-0294 D2 (2026-08-03): duplicates lower-tier proof. `uatc_ede9962b4bf236d6cb7f93ea` (`runDriftFromStore` classifies fresh | stale | drifted-undescribed from the stored anchor + change log, and an absent anchor is guidance not a crash) is proven by the capability `drift-reads-store`, at `packages/cli/src/drift-from-store.test.ts` — four tests matching the four success clauses one-to-one. Deleted by ADR-0294 D2 (2026-08-03): duplicates lower-tier proof. `uatc_9efe0576a211f525648cbfb7` (the pure source-drift classifier: described upstream change -> stale, undescribed -> demoted, unchanged -> fresh) is proven by the capability `source-drift`, at `packages/orchestrator/src/proof/source-drift.test.ts`. Observed by `binding-staleness#gate-3`. With this deletion `binding-staleness` declares ZERO UAT criteria and greens through the ADR-0085 own-proof union (ADR-0294 D4) — it is a thin cross-cutting story with no journey to walk.
